{
  const input = tf.tensor([drawing_pad], [1, 784]);

```{ojs}
{
  const samples_container = 
  d3.create('div').attr('class', 'dark-content')
  digits.incorrect_digits.forEach(async function(digit_data) {
    const input = tf.tensor([digit_data], [1, 784]);
    const prediction = model.predict(input);
    const predictedDigit = (await prediction.argMax(-1).data())[0];
    const plot = Plot.plot({
      caption: `Prediction: ${predictedDigit}`,
      color: { scheme: "Greys", reverse: true },
      width: 4 * 28,
      height: 4 * 28,
      margin: 0,
      y: { reverse: true },
      marks: [
        Plot.raster(digit_data, { width: 28, height: 28 }),
        Plot.frame()
      ]
    });
    const div = samples_container
      .append('div')
      .attr('class', 'digit-display')
    div.append(() => plot);
  });

  return samples_container.node()
}

```


```{ojs}
model = await tf.loadLayersModel('./components/cnn-model.json');
digits = await FileAttachment("./components/sample_test_data.json").json();
```
